powerPaths.label: Magnetos: ignition
powerPaths.note: Crank → idler → left/right drive gears → splined shafts → magnetos. Supplies timed ignition; two separate magnetos, twelve plugs. C-3-2; A-3-2.

powerPaths.label: Fuel: continuous-flow injection
powerPaths.note: Crank → cam cluster → fuel drive gear → coupling → fuel pump. H replacement pump coupling differs from old style. Fuel-drive numerical ratio is unverified; animation uses illustrative tooth sizes. C-3-6.

powerPaths.label: Oil and tachometer
powerPaths.note: Crank → internal cam-gear spline → oil/tach shaft → pump and 90° tach bevel pair → lateral output. Bevels are smooth pitch-form studies, not manufactured teeth. 0.5:1 is verified for tach, not a separately published oil-pump specification. A-3-2; A-4-16; C-3-2.

powerPaths.label: Starter: power into engine
powerPaths.note: Motor → worm → worm wheel → wrap spring grips drum → shaftgear → crank. After starting, spring releases; shaftgear stays engine-driven. 32:1 is starter drive/crank speed during cranking, not normal operation. A-3-2; C-3-2.

powerPaths.label: Alternator: electrical supply
powerPaths.note: Gear-driven alternator endpoint: 3:1 verified. Dashed route marks unresolved transfer geometry; A-3-2 generator-pulley wording is not an H alternator reconstruction. A-4-13; C-3-3.

powerPaths.label: Optional vacuum drive
powerPaths.note: Optional upper-rear accessory splines; adapter transfer shown schematically, not reconstructed. H vacuum, deice and autopilot drive listings are 1.14:1. Aircraft equipment depends on installation. A-3-2; C-3-3.

powerPaths.label: Governor: propeller control
powerPaths.note: Crank → camshaft → front bevel pair → governor. Remote front drive relocated; bevel geometry omitted. 0.809:1 output controls propeller pitch hydraulically. A-3-2; C-3-3.

gearForm: Involute spur teeth (20 degree pressure angle) with positive backlash, solved tooth phase and tip clearance so meshing gears touch but never overlap. Module, tooth counts and proportions are illustrative teaching choices, not manufacturer gear data.
viewpoint: CW/CCW facing each engine drive pad. Magnetos face the front side of their accessory pads (A-3-3); tach faces a lateral pad (A-4-16). Arrows follow those study shaft axes. The crank and intermediate signed rotations are inferred from external meshes and the front magneto pad viewpoint, not a directly published crank-direction specification. Grey fixtures are teaching stands. Front/optional modules are relocated and omitted transfers remain conceptual.
